maddeler.e:
أتناثر (form VI)
# أَتَنَاثَرُ (ʔatanāṯaru) /ʔa.ta.naː.θa.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَنَاثَرَ (tanāṯara)
# أَتَنَاثَرَ (ʔatanāṯara) /ʔa.ta.naː.θa.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاثَرَ (tanāṯara)
# أَتَنَاثَرْ (ʔatanāṯar) /ʔa.ta.naː.θar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاثَرَ (tanāṯara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
